headline: Food Allergy Market on the Rise: 5 Emerging Therapies to Watch | DelveInsight
summary: The current standard of care for food allergy focuses on strict avoidance of the offending allergen and the prompt use of an adrenaline auto-injector (AAI) in the event of an allergic reaction. While antihistamines, corticosteroids, and bronchodilators are frequently used to manage associated symptoms, these agents do not treat anaphylaxis and should only be considered adjunctive therapies alongside epinephrine.
